title: Ultralight Hammock – 300 kg with Straps
descriptionHtml:
Relax anywhere in nature

After a long hike you just want to sit down and rest. But the ground is often wet, hard or full of rocks.

Easy to carry, quick to set up

This hammock weighs next to nothing and holds up to 300 kg. With the included straps and carabiners you can hang it between two trees in a few minutes.

Features

  • Holds up to 300 kg
  • Ultralight and packable
  • Straps and carabiners included
  • Breathable, quick-drying fabric
  • For camping, hiking and the garden

14 days to change your mind. Counted from the day you receive the item.
